metadata.title: 16-Bit Modbus Holding Register 0x0104 (PLC_BREAKER_INTERLOCK_WORD)
metadata.description: 16-bit Modbus RTU PLC safety interlock register governing microgrid POI breaker 52-M, LOTO disconnect status, and guarded islanding arm state.

fields.name: FAULT_CODE
fields.description: 4-bit latched protection fault code (0x0 = No active protection trip).

fields.name: ISLAND_ARMED
fields.description: Two-step guarded microgrid islanding interlock armed (1 = Armed, 0 = Disarmed).

fields.name: LOTO_LOCKOUT_ACTIVE
fields.description: Physical Lockout/Tagout disconnect input (0 = Cleared, 1 = Locked out / inhibit close).

fields.name: SYNC_CHECK_OK
fields.description: IEEE 1547 synchrocheck 25 relay frequency/phase match (59.985 Hz within corridor).

fields.name: ESTOP_TRIP_LATCH
fields.description: Hardwired E-Stop trip latch. Write 1 to clear after physical pushbutton reset.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved Modbus holding bits; preserve as zero.

fields.name: BESS_DISPATCH_EN
fields.description: Grid-forming 24.0 MW BESS inverter active power dispatch enable.

fields.name: REVERSE_PWR_TRIP
fields.description: ANSI 32R reverse power protection latch. Write 1 to clear.

fields.name: TURBINE_RUN_PERM
fields.description: Gas turbine FCV-101 fuel safety chain permissive confirmed.

fields.name: BREAKER_TRIP_CMD
fields.description: Guarded POI Breaker 52-M open trip coil command (write 1 to trip).

fields.name: BREAKER_52M_CLOSED
fields.description: POI Breaker 52-M closed auxiliary contact (1 = Closed, 0 = Open).
